newsitem.title: USA: Phoenix Network merger still needs work.
newsitem.headline: Phoenix Network merger still needs work.

text.p: Phoenix Network Inc said it has been unable to reach agreement on terms and conditions of interim financing for a proposed merger with Resurgens Capital Group Inc and US ONE Communications Corp.
In addition, it said in a statement that other "substantive issues" related to the transaction had yet to be finalised.
As a result, the company has postponed a conference call it had scheduled for June 24 to discuss the deal.

"This is a very complex transaction which is subject to input from several third parties who are beyond the control of the participants in the merger," Phoenix Network president and chief executive Wallace Hammond said in a statement.
"We are working as rapidly as possible to reach agreement and complete the basic structure of the transaction."
The call has been rescheduled for 1100 EDT on June 26.
The merger is designed to create a national switch-based long-distance company and competitive local exchange carrier. US ONE and Resurgens are each privately held.
